about: Adapter of the ui-iteration-loop for the sessionspec dashboard (ui/app, built into target/ui/www). The fast loop is ui/app/e2e, run by task check:app; the rounds are ux/rounds/R-nn.
completion: the scenario's target row or panel is 100 % inside the viewport and shows the scenario's truth

metric_notes.screen_only.steers: always 0: with no guidance cue there is no cue to steer back
metric_notes.layout_shift.score: the sum of the page's layout shifts over the whole run, page load included; the scenarios run on a compressed clock, so a per-minute value would mean nothing
metric_notes.reading_load: words of visible text in the viewport at each look

dropped.L0: no guidance cue, so no engine scenario and no gate 6
